pages.name: Russian Game: Modern Attack, 3...Nxe4 4.Bd3 d5 5.Nxe5 Nd7 6.Qe2
pages.notes: Plan 2 named a 'Nd7-Nxe5' route; rewrote it around 6...Nxe5 7.Bxe4 dxe4 8.Qxe4 and the pawn sacrifice ...Be7, ...O-O (a first version said 8.Qxe4 wins the piece back at once; the reviewer rejected it, as the pinned knight only falls next move). British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Breyer Opening, Ponziani
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Nbd2-f1-g3 with the f1-bishop and then the rook on f1; now Be2, O-O, Re1 first. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: King's Knight Opening: Konstantinopolsky
pages.notes: The overview put the g2-bishop on an 'e4-d5 diagonal' (it is the h1-a8 diagonal); plan 2 had Nbd2-f1-e3 with the bishop on f1; now after Bg2, O-O and Re1. Notation and British spelling in plan 1.

pages.name: King's Pawn Game: Tayler Opening, Inverted Hanham
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the 'b1-knight to f1-g3' when it is already on d2; now Nd2-f1-g3 after Re1. British spelling in the overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Open Game: Inverted Philidor, 4.g3
pages.notes: Plan 3 had Re1 and Nbd2-f1-e3 before Bg2 and castling; reordered. British spelling in the overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Ponziani Countergambit, Cordel Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2's 'd7' read as a move (now ...Nbd7) and the f-file is half-open for Black, not open.

pages.name: Ponziani Opening: Jaenisch Counterattack
pages.notes: Plan 2 had the Nb1-d2-f1-g3 manoeuvre with the f1-bishop at home; now after Be2, O-O and Re1. '0-0' notation in plans 1 and 4. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Ponziani Opening: Réti Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a d2-f1-g3 route for the b1-knight with the bishop on f1; plan 2 put the knight on g6 and then played ...g6. Rewrote both. British spelling in the overview and plan 3.

pages.name: Ponziani: 3...Nf6 4.d4 Nxe4 5.d5 Ne7
pages.notes: Plan 1 missed that 6.Nxe5 wins the pawn back; plan 2 had ...Be7 with the knight on e7, and ...d6 against the d5-pawn (rejected by the reviewer, as ...d6 doesn't attack d5); rewrote both.

pages.name: Scotch Game: Cochrane Variation
pages.notes: The overview restricted an f6-knight that is still on g8; plan 3 had an ambiguous ...Ne7-g6. Rewrote both, adding 7...d5.
